entries.013a804da41e4195: Semiconductor and equipment manufacturers that outsource LSI design and embedded software development
entries.057855b0846ba455: This business develops packaged software, performs contract development of application software, CAD system development, Web system development, mobile device verification services, data entry operations and operator dispatch services. Its in-house developed packaged software, a comprehensive management system for housebuilders, is driving revenue. The company and KSK Techno Support Co., Ltd. are in charge; revenue from external customers was ¥6,058 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, or 23.5% of total revenue.
entries.08247b95529d5b59: End Users such as Housebuilders Adopting Packaged Software
entries.2196d176715dde9a: This business constructs, performs on-site coordination for, operates and maintains communication and computer-related systems, manages the operation of CAD systems, and handles support center operations. Mainly in the network, server and security technology fields, it handles a wide range of work, from upstream stages such as consulting and requirements definition through design, construction, and operation and maintenance. The company and KSK Techno Support Co., Ltd. are in charge; revenue from external customers was ¥15,032 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, accounting for 58.3% of total revenue, making it the core business.
entries.2ae99a5bba2a6ea8: The company is headquartered in Inagi, Tokyo, and operates three businesses: the Network Services Business, the IT Solutions Business and the System Core Business. The company and one consolidated subsidiary, KSK Techno Support Co., Ltd., make up the group; for the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥25,767 million and the number of employees was 2,709. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.5e906fb99af12855: Companies and Government Agencies Outsourcing Network Construction and Operation and Maintenance
entries.9e59d85cd4867180: An information services company that handles network construction, operation and maintenance, software development, LSI design and more.
entries.b00b9923fa3bff32: This business handles semiconductor design work centered on system LSIs, embedded software development work for IoT devices and other equipment, and hardware design work for various devices. Orders are growing for mechanical design of communication equipment components and for design and development of medical devices, including in semiconductor fields such as image sensors. Only the company handles this business, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,675 million, or 18.1% of total revenue.
